summary: Emit canonical agent identities in mission presentation and admit canonical mission work actors

replay.detail: Historical rows remain unchanged; presentation canonicalizes legacy slash-qualified agent identities on read. Re-parsing stored declarations preserves historical host-relative qualification and malformed assignee normalization rather than rejecting them.

schema.detail: The strict client AgentId schema and database schema are unchanged.

rules.detail: Mission assignees, run-start actors and work actions canonicalize slash-qualified agent identities. Work eligibility, reads, renewal, successor lookup and capacity accounting compare canonical identities; malformed work actors are rejected. Work read filters retain default-agent qualification for bare names, including published lists and explicit ready-work queue ordering.

compatibility.detail: Capability-gated expansion: all current fleet members must advertise work-claimant-legacy-admission before writers preserve legacy assignee/candidate spelling in lease ownership. Until then ownership writes retain the prior behavior, avoiding facts rejected by older validators. Readers, queue selection and capacity compare canonical identities. LIVE-MIGRATION BRIDGE arn:lmig:fractal:2026-11-07-agent-actor-ownership contracts after fleet-wide canonical comparison/admission support, when a later change migrates stored rows and removes the exception.

downtime.detail: No downtime or stored-row migration is required for expansion; legacy ownership writes stay gated until fleet-wide admission support is observed.

recovery.detail: Lease fencing remains unchanged. Signed legacy work ownership can arrive before its target row during cold import; projection checks canonical eligibility and records a defect without taking the lease if the target selector does not match.
